question: Who among the following became India’ s youngest ever mayor in December 2020? The 21-year-old is currently serving as the mayor of Thiruvananthapuram Corporation.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Arya Rajendran.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mayor is the First Citizen of the City.**
 
• **In December 2020 Arya Rajendran** become the youngest mayor of India (21 years) in the **Thiruvananthapuram **city of Kerala.
 
• She secured** 54 votes in the 100-member Council in the election held on December 28**.
 
• The head of the **Municipal Corporation of the respective city elected by the public is called Mayor.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Rajni Abbi
 Rajni Abbi is a leader of Bharatiya Janata Party and a law professor. She was the mayor of Delhi.
 
 

 Mira Aggarwal
 Mira Aggarwal is an Indian politician of the Bharatiya Janata Party. She is the first Mayor of the newly constituted North Delhi Municipal Corporation. She was the first lady to be appointed at the post of Deputy Mayor of Delhi in 1998.
 
 

 Chhavi Rajawat
 Chhavi Rajawat was the Sarpanch of her village Soda, 60 kilometres from Jaipur. Though holding an elected post, she is not affiliated with any political party.
